text_en: David asked, “Is there still anyone left of the house of Saul to whom I may show kindness for Jonathan’s sake? ”
text_cn: 达味问说：“撒乌耳家中还有剩下的人吗？为了约纳堂，我要对他表示慈爱。”

text_en: Now there was a servant of the house of Saul whose name was Ziba, and he was summoned to David. The king said to him, “Are you Ziba? ” And he said, “At your service! ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳家有一个仆人，名叫漆巴，有人把他带到达味前；君王问他说：“你是漆巴吗？”他答说：“你的仆人是。”

text_en: The king said, “Is there anyone remaining of the house of Saul to whom I may show the kindness of God? ” Ziba said to the king, “There remains a son of Jonathan; he is crippled in his feet. ”
text_cn: 君王又问他说：“撒乌耳家中还有什么人在吗？我好对他表示天主的慈爱。” 漆巴回答君王说：“还有约纳堂的一个双脚跛瘸的儿子。”

text_en: The king said to him, “Where is he? ” Ziba said to the king, “He is in the house of Machir son of Ammiel, at Lo-debar. ”
text_cn: 君王向他说：“他在哪里？”漆巴回答君王说：“他在罗德巴尔，阿米耳的儿子玛基尔家里。”

text_en: Then King David sent and brought him from the house of Machir son of Ammiel, at Lo-debar.
text_cn: 达味派人从罗德巴尔，阿米耳的儿子玛基尔家里把他接来。

text_en: Mephibosheth son of Jonathan son of Saul came to David, and fell on his face and did obeisance. David said, “Mephibosheth! ” He answered, “I am your servant. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳的孙子、约纳堂的儿子，默黎巴耳来到达味前，就俯伏在地，叩拜君王。达味说：“默黎巴耳！”他答说：“你的仆人在这里。”

text_en: David said to him, “Do not be afraid, for I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan; I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you yourself shall eat at my table always. ”
text_cn: 达味向他说：“你不要害怕，为了你的父亲约纳堂，我要恩待你，将你祖父撒乌耳所有的土地全归还给你；你以后要享用我桌上的食物。”

text_en: He did obeisance and said, “What is your servant, that you should look upon a dead dog such as I? ”
text_cn: 他伏首至地叩拜说：“你的仆人算什么？你竟来眷顾像我这样的一个死狗。”

text_en: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s grandson.
text_cn: 君王把撒乌耳的仆人漆巴召来，向他说：“撒乌耳和他全家所有的一切，我全给了你主人的儿子。

text_en: You and your sons and your servants shall till the land for him, and shall bring in the produce, so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat; but your master’s grandson Mephibosheth shall always eat at my table. ” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
text_cn: 所以，你和你的儿子以及你的仆役，应为他耕种田地，将收获供给你主人的家庭作食粮；但你主人的儿子默黎巴耳要常享用我桌上的食物。”漆巴有十五个儿子，二十个仆役。

text_en: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do. ” Mephibosheth ate at David’s table, like one of the king’s sons.
text_cn: 漆巴回答君王说：“凡我主大王吩咐你仆人的，你的仆人必全依照遵行。”如此，默黎巴耳享用君王桌上的食物，就如君王的一个儿子。

text_en: Mephibosheth had a young son whose name was Mica. And all who lived in Ziba’s house became Mephibosheth’s servants.
text_cn: 默黎巴耳有个小儿，名叫米加。凡住在漆巴家里的人，无不服事默黎巴耳。

text_en: Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he always ate at the king’s table. Now he was lame in both his feet.
text_cn: 默黎巴耳常住在耶路撒冷，因为他应常享用君王桌上的食物，只是他的双脚跛了。
